title: Identification and Characterization of ORF1ab Polyprotein of SARS-CoV-2
author: Zolfaghari Emameh, Nosrati, et al.

steps.title: Retrieve SARS‑CoV‑2 sequences
steps.instruction: Download the Iranian SARS‑CoV‑2 nucleotide and protein entries from the NCBI Virus database.

substeps.instruction: Search for accession number MT152900 and download the CDS (322 bases) isolated from the oronasopharynx of an Iranian patient (recorded on 2020‑02‑26). Record the full annotation: "Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 isolate SARS‑CoV‑2/MHKN‑1/human/2020/IRN ORF1ab polyprotein (orf1ab) gene, partial cds (Karbalaie Niya,M.H., et al.)".
Also retrieve the protein entry with accession number QIH55230, which corresponds to a partial ORF1ab polyprotein of 107 amino acids.

steps.title: Run Clustal Omega alignments
steps.instruction: Perform multiple‑sequence alignments of the Iranian and Wuhan reference sequences using the Clustal Omega web tool.

substeps.instruction: For nucleotide alignment: paste or upload the Iranian CDS (MT152900) and the Wuhan reference CDS (NC_045512.2) and run the MSA using the default Clustal Omega settings.
For protein alignment: paste or upload the Iranian partial ORF1ab polyprotein (QIH55230) and the Wuhan reference protein (YP_009724389.1) and run the MSA using the same tool.
